attributes.value: CategoryProfile_<CategoryId> names the audio profile for every vehicle of that category. It applies only while the vehicle carries the server's default profile stamp; a package resolved by an authoritative owner and a template's own StandardAudioProfileId still win. Blank or unknown values fall back to the normal resolution.

instances.name: FeelAudioEnabled
instances.value: Master switch for the feel drive (rev layers, load follower, forced induction, slip strain, drift charge, impacts). False makes every profile behave as it did before, including profiles with FeelDriveEnabled.

instances.name: ImpactLightStuds
instances.value: Smallest FeelImpactStrength (studs per second of unexplained speed change) that plays the light impact one-shot. Weaker impacts are silent.

instances.name: ImpactMediumStuds
instances.value: FeelImpactStrength from which the medium impact one-shot is chosen.

instances.name: ImpactHeavyStuds
instances.value: FeelImpactStrength from which the heavy impact one-shot is chosen.

instances.name: ImpactSevereStuds
instances.value: FeelImpactStrength from which the severe impact one-shot is chosen.

instances.name: ImpactMinIntervalSeconds
instances.value: Shortest time between two impact one-shots on one vehicle; impacts inside this window are dropped.

instances.name: FeelVoiceSleepSeconds
instances.value: How long a feel loop stays at zero gain before its player stops. It restarts when the layer is next needed.

instances.name: FeelLayerFadeInSeconds
instances.value: Response time when a feel loop (turbo, supercharger, turbine, hum, slip strain, drift charge) rises.

instances.name: FeelLayerFadeOutSeconds
instances.value: Response time when a feel loop falls.

instances.name: RevHandoverSeconds
instances.value: Length of the equal-power swap from the standard engine loops (Idle, EngineLow, EngineHigh) to the rev layers once the first rev layer asset has loaded. Until then, and for good if none loads, the standard engine loops stay.

instances.name: RevLayerSmoothingSeconds
instances.value: Anti-click smoothing on rev layer gains. Keep it short: the load follower and the rev crossfade supply the audible shape.

instances.name: LocalFeelUpdateHz
instances.value: How often the local driver's feel voices are updated on desktop. Only that one vehicle uses it; every other vehicle and every standard layer stays on ParameterUpdateHz.

instances.name: LocalFeelUpdateHzMobile
instances.value: The same rate on small touch devices.

instances.name: TwinEngineEnabled
instances.value: Allows the detuned second copy of the on-load rev layers (twin engine beat) for the local driver.

instances.name: TwinEngineOnMobile
instances.value: Allows the twin engine copy on small touch devices. Off by default to halve the playing engine voices on mobile.

instances.name: MaxRevLayerPlayers
instances.value: Most rev layer AudioPlayers created for the local driver's vehicle, twin copies included (hard limit 16).

instances.name: MaxRevLayerPlayersMobile
instances.value: The same limit on small touch devices.

instances.name: MaxRemoteRevLayerPlayers
instances.value: Most looping AudioPlayers on any vehicle the local player is not driving when its profile has rev layers (hard limit 3).

children.name: AccelerationAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the sustained loop while conditioned forward acceleration remains active. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: AccelerationEnterAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the managed one-shot after forward acceleration passes its confirmation window. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: AccelerationEnterGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the managed one-shot after forward acceleration passes its confirmation window; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: AccelerationEnterPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the managed one-shot after forward acceleration passes its confirmation window; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: AccelerationGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the sustained loop while conditioned forward acceleration remains active; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: AccelerationPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the sustained loop while conditioned forward acceleration remains active; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: AccelerationReleaseAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the managed one-shot after a confirmed acceleration session remains released. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: AccelerationReleaseGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the managed one-shot after a confirmed acceleration session remains released; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: AccelerationReleasePitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the managed one-shot after a confirmed acceleration session remains released; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: BoostEmptyAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the one-shot when a non-full qualifying boost session drains the tank. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: BoostEmptyGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the one-shot when a non-full qualifying boost session drains the tank; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: BoostEmptyPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the one-shot when a non-full qualifying boost session drains the tank; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: BoostEnterAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the one-shot when boost begins. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: BoostEnterGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the one-shot when boost begins; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: BoostEnterPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the one-shot when boost begins; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: BoostLoopAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the continuous layer while boost presentation remains active. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile. Synthesised file for this profile: boost_loop. While this is blank the profile borrows the fallback profile's boost layers; once it is set, blank boost layers (BoostEnter and so on) stay silent.

children.name: BoostLoopGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the continuous layer while boost presentation remains active; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: BoostLoopPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the continuous layer while boost presentation remains active; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: BoostRechargeAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the driver-only cancellable one-shot when boost charge actually begins rising. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: BoostRechargeGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the driver-only cancellable one-shot when boost charge actually begins rising; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: BoostRechargePitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the driver-only cancellable one-shot when boost charge actually begins rising; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: BoostReleaseAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the one-shot when boost is released without emptying the tank. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile. Synthesised file for this profile: boost_release.

children.name: BoostReleaseGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the one-shot when boost is released without emptying the tank; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: BoostReleasePitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the one-shot when boost is released without emptying the tank; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: CoastAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the loop while running above CoastStartMph without accelerating. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: CoastGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the loop while running above CoastStartMph without accelerating; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: CoastPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the loop while running above CoastStartMph without accelerating; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: DisplayName
children.value: Editor-facing name of this complete vehicle sound package; changing it does not change the stable profile folder ID.

children.name: DriftEnterAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the one-shot when a drift begins. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: DriftEnterGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the one-shot when a drift begins; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: DriftEnterPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the one-shot when a drift begins; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: DriftLoopAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the continuous drift layer whose gain and pitch build with uninterrupted drift duration. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: DriftLoopGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the continuous drift layer whose gain and pitch build with uninterrupted drift duration; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: DriftLoopPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the continuous drift layer whose gain and pitch build with uninterrupted drift duration; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: DriverWindAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the driver-only loop faded in by vehicle speed. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile. Synthesised file for this profile: wind_rush (the toolbox body/drag loop stands in until then).

children.name: DriverWindGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the driver-only loop faded in by vehicle speed; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: DriverWindPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the driver-only loop faded in by vehicle speed; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: EngineHighAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the high-speed engine loop faded in between its configured speed thresholds. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: EngineHighGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the high-speed engine loop faded in between its configured speed thresholds; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: EngineHighPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the high-speed engine loop faded in between its configured speed thresholds; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: EngineLowAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the low-speed engine loop shaped around EngineLowPeakMph. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile. In this profile it is the engine voice until a rev layer has loaded (and for good if none loads), on Simple-tier remote vehicles, and when FeelAudioEnabled is false.

children.name: EngineLowGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the low-speed engine loop shaped around EngineLowPeakMph; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: EngineLowPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the low-speed engine loop shaped around EngineLowPeakMph; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: FullBoostSpentAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the special one-shot when a near-full tank is continuously consumed to empty. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: FullBoostSpentGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the special one-shot when a near-full tank is continuously consumed to empty; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: FullBoostSpentPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the special one-shot when a near-full tank is continuously consumed to empty; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: IdleAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the loop strongest near stationary and reduced as vehicle speed rises. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile. In this profile it is the idle voice until a rev layer has loaded (and for good if none loads), and when FeelAudioEnabled is false.

children.name: IdleGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the loop strongest near stationary and reduced as vehicle speed rises; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: IdlePitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the loop strongest near stationary and reduced as vehicle speed rises; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: IgnitionAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the one-shot when a valid driver starts a vehicle audio session. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: IgnitionGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the one-shot when a valid driver starts a vehicle audio session; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: IgnitionPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the one-shot when a valid driver starts a vehicle audio session; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: ProfileMasterGain
children.value: Master multiplier for every loop and one-shot in this complete vehicle sound package; use it to normalise packages without retuning every layer.

children.name: ProfileRevision
children.value: Editor-managed revision number for the complete sound package's assets and tuning values.

children.name: ShutdownAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the one-shot when the running vehicle audio session shuts down. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: ShutdownGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the one-shot when the running vehicle audio session shuts down; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: ShutdownPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the one-shot when the running vehicle audio session shuts down; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: AccelerationDisabled
children.value: True switches the Acceleration layer off for this profile whatever its asset id is (the rev layers and turbo carry acceleration). Any layer accepts <Layer>Disabled.

children.name: CoastDisabled
children.value: True switches the Coast layer off for this profile whatever its asset id is (the off-load rev layers carry coasting). Any layer accepts <Layer>Disabled.

children.name: DriftLoopDisabled
children.value: True switches the DriftLoop layer off for this profile whatever its asset id is (the stabiliser strain layer carries drifting). Any layer accepts <Layer>Disabled.

children.name: AccelerationEnterDisabled
children.value: True switches the AccelerationEnter layer off for this profile whatever its asset id is (the tip-in bark replaces it). Any layer accepts <Layer>Disabled.

children.name: AccelerationReleaseDisabled
children.value: True switches the AccelerationRelease layer off for this profile whatever its asset id is (the blow-off and pops replace it). Any layer accepts <Layer>Disabled.

children.name: DriftEnterDisabled
children.value: True switches the DriftEnter layer off for this profile whatever its asset id is (the stabiliser strain layer replaces it). Any layer accepts <Layer>Disabled.

children.name: FeelDriveEnabled
children.value: Opts this profile into the feel drive: rev layers, load follower, forced induction, slip strain, drift charge and impact layers. False or missing keeps the standard speed-shaped behaviour.

children.name: AccelerationRevPitchMin
children.value: Playback-speed multiplier of the sustained acceleration loop at rev 0. With AccelerationRevPitchMax it makes that loop follow rev; remove both to keep its pitch fixed.

children.name: AccelerationRevPitchMax
children.value: Playback-speed multiplier of the sustained acceleration loop at rev 1.

children.name: BoostLoopRevPitchMin
children.value: Playback-speed multiplier of the boost loop (thruster roar) at rev 0. With BoostLoopRevPitchMax it makes that loop follow rev.

children.name: BoostLoopRevPitchMax
children.value: Playback-speed multiplier of the boost loop (thruster roar) at rev 1.

children.name: TurbineLowAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the lower synthesised turbine loop (turbine_low); it carries the turbine from TurbineStartRev and crossfades into TurbineHigh one octave up. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: TurbineLowGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the lower synthesised turbine loop (turbine_low); it carries the turbine from TurbineStartRev and crossfades into TurbineHigh one octave up; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: TurbineLowPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the lower synthesised turbine loop (turbine_low); it carries the turbine from TurbineStartRev and crossfades into TurbineHigh one octave up. The sweep itself comes from TurbineOctaveStart and TurbineOctaves.

children.name: TurbineHighAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the upper synthesised turbine loop (turbine_high), recorded one octave above TurbineLow. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: TurbineHighGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the upper synthesised turbine loop (turbine_high), recorded one octave above TurbineLow; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: TurbineHighPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the upper synthesised turbine loop (turbine_high), recorded one octave above TurbineLow. The sweep itself comes from TurbineOctaveStart and TurbineOctaves.

children.name: TurboWhistleAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the turbo whistle loop driven by spool (spool rises with load and rev, falls on lift). Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: TurboWhistleGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the turbo whistle loop driven by spool (spool rises with load and rev, falls on lift); 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: TurboWhistlePitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the turbo whistle loop driven by spool (spool rises with load and rev, falls on lift); it scales the PitchMin to PitchMax sweep.

children.name: TurboWhistlePitchMin
children.value: Playback speed of the turbo whistle loop driven by spool (spool rises with load and rev, falls on lift) when its drive value is 0.

children.name: TurboWhistlePitchMax
children.value: Playback speed of the turbo whistle loop driven by spool (spool rises with load and rev, falls on lift) when its drive value is 1.

children.name: SuperchargerWhineAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the supercharger whine loop driven by rev. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: SuperchargerWhineGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the supercharger whine loop driven by rev; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: SuperchargerWhinePitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the supercharger whine loop driven by rev; it scales the PitchMin to PitchMax sweep.

children.name: SuperchargerWhinePitchMin
children.value: Playback speed of the supercharger whine loop driven by rev when its drive value is 0.

children.name: SuperchargerWhinePitchMax
children.value: Playback speed of the supercharger whine loop driven by rev when its drive value is 1.

children.name: EnergyHumAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the synthesised hover energy hum loop, steady while driving and lifted by hover compression. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: EnergyHumGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the synthesised hover energy hum loop, steady while driving and lifted by hover compression; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: EnergyHumPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the synthesised hover energy hum loop, steady while driving and lifted by hover compression; it scales the PitchMin to PitchMax sweep.

children.name: EnergyHumPitchMin
children.value: Playback speed of the synthesised hover energy hum loop, steady while driving and lifted by hover compression when its drive value is 0.

children.name: EnergyHumPitchMax
children.value: Playback speed of the synthesised hover energy hum loop, steady while driving and lifted by hover compression when its drive value is 1.

children.name: SlipStrainAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the stabiliser strain loop driven by sideways slip and drifting; the engine ducks under it. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: SlipStrainGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the stabiliser strain loop driven by sideways slip and drifting; the engine ducks under it; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: SlipStrainPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the stabiliser strain loop driven by sideways slip and drifting; the engine ducks under it; it scales the PitchMin to PitchMax sweep.

children.name: SlipStrainPitchMin
children.value: Playback speed of the stabiliser strain loop driven by sideways slip and drifting; the engine ducks under it when its drive value is 0.

children.name: SlipStrainPitchMax
children.value: Playback speed of the stabiliser strain loop driven by sideways slip and drifting; the engine ducks under it when its drive value is 1.

children.name: DriftChargeAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the synthesised drift charge tone whose pitch climbs with FeelDriftCharge. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: DriftChargeGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the synthesised drift charge tone whose pitch climbs with FeelDriftCharge; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: DriftChargePitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the synthesised drift charge tone whose pitch climbs with FeelDriftCharge; it scales the PitchMin to PitchMax sweep.

children.name: DriftChargePitchMin
children.value: Playback speed of the synthesised drift charge tone whose pitch climbs with FeelDriftCharge when its drive value is 0.

children.name: DriftChargePitchMax
children.value: Playback speed of the synthesised drift charge tone whose pitch climbs with FeelDriftCharge when its drive value is 1.

children.name: BoostBodyAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the thruster roar loop under the boost loop (thruster_roar); full for a held boost, BoostLoopMiniGain for a mini-boost, pitch follows rev. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: BoostBodyGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the thruster roar loop under the boost loop (thruster_roar); full for a held boost, BoostLoopMiniGain for a mini-boost, pitch follows rev; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: BoostBodyPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the thruster roar loop under the boost loop (thruster_roar); full for a held boost, BoostLoopMiniGain for a mini-boost, pitch follows rev; it scales the PitchMin to PitchMax sweep.

children.name: BoostBodyPitchMin
children.value: Playback speed of the thruster roar loop under the boost loop (thruster_roar); full for a held boost, BoostLoopMiniGain for a mini-boost, pitch follows rev when its drive value is 0.

children.name: BoostBodyPitchMax
children.value: Playback speed of the thruster roar loop under the boost loop (thruster_roar); full for a held boost, BoostLoopMiniGain for a mini-boost, pitch follows rev when its drive value is 1.

children.name: WindBuffetAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the high-speed wind buffet loop (wind_buffet) that enters between WindBuffetStartMph and WindBuffetFullMph. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: WindBuffetGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the high-speed wind buffet loop (wind_buffet) that enters between WindBuffetStartMph and WindBuffetFullMph; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: WindBuffetPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the high-speed wind buffet loop (wind_buffet) that enters between WindBuffetStartMph and WindBuffetFullMph; it scales the PitchMin to PitchMax sweep.

children.name: WindBuffetPitchMin
children.value: Playback speed of the high-speed wind buffet loop (wind_buffet) that enters between WindBuffetStartMph and WindBuffetFullMph when its drive value is 0.

children.name: WindBuffetPitchMax
children.value: Playback speed of the high-speed wind buffet loop (wind_buffet) that enters between WindBuffetStartMph and WindBuffetFullMph when its drive value is 1.

children.name: BlowOffAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the blow-off one-shot when the throttle is lifted after sustained load, or a boost ends, scaled by spool. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: BlowOffGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the blow-off one-shot when the throttle is lifted after sustained load, or a boost ends, scaled by spool; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: BlowOffPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the blow-off one-shot when the throttle is lifted after sustained load, or a boost ends, scaled by spool; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: TurboFlutterAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the synthesised turbo flutter one-shot (turbo_flutter), played instead of the blow-off when spool is below FlutterBelowSpool, or always when the blow-off slot is empty. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: TurboFlutterGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the synthesised turbo flutter one-shot (turbo_flutter), played instead of the blow-off when spool is below FlutterBelowSpool, or always when the blow-off slot is empty; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: TurboFlutterPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the synthesised turbo flutter one-shot (turbo_flutter), played instead of the blow-off when spool is below FlutterBelowSpool, or always when the blow-off slot is empty; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: BoostIgnitionAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the synthesised boost ignition one-shot when FeelBoostKind changes from none to Boost or Mini. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: BoostIgnitionGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the synthesised boost ignition one-shot when FeelBoostKind changes from none to Boost or Mini; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: BoostIgnitionPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the synthesised boost ignition one-shot when FeelBoostKind changes from none to Boost or Mini; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: DriftChargeReleaseAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the synthesised release one-shot when a drift mini-boost fires, scaled by the charge that was built. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: DriftChargeReleaseGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the synthesised release one-shot when a drift mini-boost fires, scaled by the charge that was built; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: DriftChargeReleasePitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the synthesised release one-shot when a drift mini-boost fires, scaled by the charge that was built; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: ImpactLightAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the synthesised light impact one-shot (from ImpactLightStuds). Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: ImpactLightGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the synthesised light impact one-shot (from ImpactLightStuds); 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: ImpactLightPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the synthesised light impact one-shot (from ImpactLightStuds); 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: ImpactMediumAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the synthesised medium impact one-shot (from ImpactMediumStuds). Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: ImpactMediumGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the synthesised medium impact one-shot (from ImpactMediumStuds); 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: ImpactMediumPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the synthesised medium impact one-shot (from ImpactMediumStuds); 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: ImpactHeavyAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the synthesised heavy impact one-shot (from ImpactHeavyStuds). Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: ImpactHeavyGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the synthesised heavy impact one-shot (from ImpactHeavyStuds); 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: ImpactHeavyPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the synthesised heavy impact one-shot (from ImpactHeavyStuds); 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: ImpactSevereAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the synthesised severe impact one-shot (from ImpactSevereStuds). Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: ImpactSevereGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the synthesised severe impact one-shot (from ImpactSevereStuds); 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: ImpactSeverePitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the synthesised severe impact one-shot (from ImpactSevereStuds); 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: LandingThumpAssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for the synthesised landing thump one-shot on FeelLandRevision, scaled by touchdown speed. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: LandingThumpGain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for the synthesised landing thump one-shot on FeelLandRevision, scaled by touchdown speed; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: LandingThumpPitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for the synthesised landing thump one-shot on FeelLandRevision, scaled by touchdown speed; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: Pop1AssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for exhaust pop 1 (pop_1); pops are drawn from a shuffled bag of Pop1..Pop4 on FeelPopRevision when FeelPopStrength is under PopBangStrength, gain scaled by strength. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: Pop1Gain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for exhaust pop 1 (pop_1); pops are drawn from a shuffled bag of Pop1..Pop4 on FeelPopRevision when FeelPopStrength is under PopBangStrength, gain scaled by strength; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: Pop1Pitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for exhaust pop 1 (pop_1); pops are drawn from a shuffled bag of Pop1..Pop4 on FeelPopRevision when FeelPopStrength is under PopBangStrength, gain scaled by strength; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: Pop2AssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for exhaust pop 2 (pop_2). Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: Pop2Gain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for exhaust pop 2 (pop_2); 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: Pop2Pitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for exhaust pop 2 (pop_2); 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: Pop3AssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for exhaust pop 3 (pop_3). Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: Pop3Gain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for exhaust pop 3 (pop_3); 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: Pop3Pitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for exhaust pop 3 (pop_3); 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: Pop4AssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for exhaust pop 4 (pop_4). Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: Pop4Gain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for exhaust pop 4 (pop_4); 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: Pop4Pitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for exhaust pop 4 (pop_4); 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: Bang1AssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for exhaust bang 1 (bang_1); played on FeelPopRevision when FeelPopStrength is at or over PopBangStrength. Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: Bang1Gain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for exhaust bang 1 (bang_1); played on FeelPopRevision when FeelPopStrength is at or over PopBangStrength; 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: Bang1Pitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for exhaust bang 1 (bang_1); played on FeelPopRevision when FeelPopStrength is at or over PopBangStrength; 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: Bang2AssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID for exhaust bang 2 (bang_2). Blank disables this layer without affecting the rest of the profile.

children.name: Bang2Gain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for exhaust bang 2 (bang_2); 0 is silent, 1 is the asset's base level, and values above 1 amplify it.

children.name: Bang2Pitch
children.value: Base playback-speed/pitch multiplier for exhaust bang 2 (bang_2); 1 is original, below 1 is lower/slower, and above 1 is higher/faster.

children.name: RevThrottleWeight
children.value: Share of rev that comes from engine load (throttle). rev = RevThrottleWeight x load + RevSpeedWeight x speed / RevReferenceMph + RevBoostWeight x boost, limited to 0..1.

children.name: RevSpeedWeight
children.value: Share of rev that comes from road speed.

children.name: RevBoostWeight
children.value: Rev added while boosting (scaled down for a mini-boost).

children.name: RevReferenceMph
children.value: Speed at which the speed share of rev is full. Set it near the category's top speed.

children.name: RevRiseSeconds
children.value: Response time when rev rises.

children.name: RevFallSeconds
children.value: Response time when rev falls.

children.name: RevPitchBase
children.value: Engine frequency at rev 0 as a fraction of rev 1 (idle rpm / top rpm; 1000 / 8000 here). Rev layers are pitched and crossfaded on this scale.

children.name: RevNeighbourDetune
children.value: Opposite detune applied to neighbouring rev layers so an overlap does not cancel (0.003 = 0.3 %, limit 0.6 %).

children.name: RevOffLoadGain
children.value: Off-load level of a rev layer whose Load is Any, relative to its on-load level.

children.name: RevMasterGain
children.value: Multiplier for every rev layer in this profile.

children.name: ReverseLoad
children.value: Engine load used while reversing, as a fraction of full throttle.

children.name: LoadAttackSeconds
children.value: Load follower response when throttle is applied.

children.name: LoadReleaseSeconds
children.value: Load follower response when throttle is released.

children.name: LoadExponent
children.value: Curve applied to load before the thrust/coast swap; below 1 brings the thrust set in sooner.

children.name: BarkGain
children.value: Extra on-load gain at tip-in (the bark). 0 disables it.

children.name: BarkSeconds
children.value: How quickly the tip-in bark dies away.

children.name: LifePitchDepth
children.value: Typical size of the slow random pitch drift on the local engine (0.0025 = 0.25 %). 0 disables it.

children.name: LifeLevelDb
children.value: Typical size of the slow random level drift on the local engine, in decibels.

children.name: LifeSeconds
children.value: Time scale of the slow drift.

children.name: TwinEngineDetune
children.value: Detune of the second copy of each on-load rev layer (twin engine beat). 0 disables the copy.

children.name: TwinEngineGain
children.value: Level of the twin copy relative to the main copy. 0 disables the copy.

children.name: TurboSpoolUpSeconds
children.value: Response time when turbo spool rises.

children.name: TurboSpoolDownSeconds
children.value: Response time when turbo spool falls.

children.name: TurboSpoolRevFloor
children.value: Spool reached at full load and rev 0; it grows to 1 at rev 1.

children.name: TurboGainExponent
children.value: Curve from spool to turbo whistle gain; above 1 keeps the whistle quiet until spool is high.

children.name: BlowOffLoadThreshold
children.value: Throttle at or above which load counts as sustained for the blow-off.

children.name: BlowOffLiftThreshold
children.value: Throttle at or below which a lift is detected.

children.name: BlowOffMinLoadSeconds
children.value: Sustained load needed before a lift fires the blow-off.

children.name: BlowOffMinSpool
children.value: Least spool for a blow-off; its gain scales with spool.

children.name: BlowOffMinIntervalSeconds
children.value: Shortest time between two blow-offs.

children.name: BlowOffSpoolKeep
children.value: Fraction of spool left after a blow-off.

children.name: SuperchargerGainExponent
children.value: Curve from rev to supercharger whine gain.

children.name: SuperchargerOffLoadGain
children.value: Supercharger whine level off load, relative to on load.

children.name: TurbineStartRev
children.value: Rev at which the turbine pair starts to enter; it is full at rev 1.

children.name: TurbineOffLoadGain
children.value: Turbine level off load, relative to on load.

children.name: TurbineOctaveStart
children.value: Turbine pitch at rev 0, in octaves relative to the TurbineLow recording. TurbineLow plays at 2^octave, TurbineHigh one octave below that; the pair crossfades between octave 0 and 1.

children.name: TurbineOctaves
children.value: Octaves the turbine climbs between rev 0 and rev 1.

children.name: FlutterBelowSpool
children.value: Spool below which a lift plays TurboFlutter instead of BlowOff.

children.name: EnergyHumHoverGain
children.value: Extra energy hum gain per unit of hover compression (FeelHover).

children.name: SlipStart
children.value: Sideways slip at which stabiliser strain starts.

children.name: SlipFull
children.value: Sideways slip at which stabiliser strain is full.

children.name: SlipDriftFloor
children.value: Slip assumed while a drift is active, so strain is heard through the whole drift.

children.name: SlipDuckDb
children.value: Most the engine is turned down under full stabiliser strain, in decibels. Only applies when the SlipStrain layer has an asset.

children.name: SlipDuckInSeconds
children.value: How fast the engine ducks.

children.name: SlipDuckOutSeconds
children.value: How fast the engine recovers.

children.name: BoostLoopMiniGain
children.value: BoostLoop level during a drift mini-boost, relative to a held boost.

children.name: BoostIgnitionMiniGain
children.value: Boost ignition level for a mini-boost, relative to a held boost.

children.name: BoostIgnitionMiniPitch
children.value: Boost ignition playback speed for a mini-boost.

children.name: DriftChargeStart
children.value: FeelDriftCharge at which the charge tone starts.

children.name: DriftChargeFull
children.value: FeelDriftCharge at which the charge tone reaches full gain. Its pitch keeps climbing to charge 1.

children.name: LandMinStuds
children.value: Slowest touchdown (studs per second downward) that plays the landing thump.

children.name: LandFullStuds
children.value: Touchdown speed at which the landing thump is at full gain.

children.name: LandMinGain
children.value: Landing thump gain at LandMinStuds, relative to full.

children.name: BoostFadeInSeconds
children.value: Fade-in of BoostLoop and BoostBody, so the boost lands with its ignition.

children.name: BoostDuckDb
children.value: How far the rev layers are turned down while boosting, in decibels. Only applies when BoostLoop or BoostBody has an asset.

children.name: BoostDuckInSeconds
children.value: How fast the engine ducks under a boost.

children.name: BoostDuckOutSeconds
children.value: How fast the engine recovers after a boost.

children.name: PopBangStrength
children.value: FeelPopStrength at or above which a bang (Bang1/Bang2) plays instead of a pop.

children.name: PopPitchJitter
children.value: Random playback-speed spread on each pop or bang (0.06 = plus or minus 6 %).

children.name: DriverWindStartMph
children.value: Speed at which driver wind starts to be heard on this profile.

children.name: DriverWindFullMph
children.value: Speed at which driver wind is at full gain and top pitch. Gain follows (speed / DriverWindFullMph) ^ DriverWindExponent.

children.name: DriverWindExponent
children.value: Power curve of driver wind gain against speed.

children.name: DriverWindSpeedPitchMin
children.value: Driver wind playback speed at rest.

children.name: DriverWindSpeedPitchMax
children.value: Driver wind playback speed at DriverWindFullMph.

children.name: WindBuffetStartMph
children.value: Speed at which the wind buffet loop starts to enter.

children.name: WindBuffetFullMph
children.value: Speed at which the wind buffet loop is full.

children.name: AssetId
children.value: Roblox audio asset ID of this steady engine loop. Blank leaves the layer absent.

children.name: Rev
children.value: Rev position (0..1) the loop was recorded at. The loop plays at its natural pitch there and crossfades equal-power with its neighbours in the same Load set.

children.name: Gain
children.value: Linear mix multiplier for this loop.

children.name: Pitch
children.value: Trim on the loop's playback speed; 1 means the recording matches its Rev position exactly.

children.name: PitchMin
children.value: Lowest playback speed this loop may be pulled to.

children.name: PitchMax
children.value: Highest playback speed this loop may be pushed to.

children.name: Load
children.value: On = thrust set (heard under throttle), Off = coast set (heard off throttle), Any = both. A set with no partner set plays at every load.

children.name: StandIn
children.value: True marks a temporary loop: every stand-in is dropped as soon as one layer that is not a stand-in has an asset.

children.name: Twin
children.value: True lets this loop get a detuned second copy for the local driver (twin engine beat). Off-load loops never get one.

children.name: Enabled
children.value: False removes this layer without clearing its asset.
